title: Police Blotter: 20 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Twenty people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Nov. 25–27, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, family-violence assault, theft and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Twenty people were booked into the Webb County Jail from Wednesday through Friday, November 25–27, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge or hold shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Carla Selene Malacara

Malacara was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 10:36 p.m. on a charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Evelyn Navarro-Hogan

Navarro-Hogan was arrested on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 11:20 p.m. on a charge of theft of property valued at $100 or more but less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Jose Serna III

Serna was arrested on Thursday, November 26, 2026, at 12:23 a.m. on a charge of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $500. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Cristina P. Arzagoitia-Lerma

Arzagoitia-Lerma was arrested by the Laredo Police Department on Thursday, November 26, 2026, at 2:09 a.m. on two counts of driving while intoxicated, each a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either count at the time of booking.

Elvis Roberto Martinez

Martinez was arrested on Thursday, November 26, 2026, at 3:10 a.m. on a charge of terroristic threat causing fear of imminent serious bodily injury, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Miguel Angel Rodriguez

Rodriguez was arrested on Thursday, November 26, 2026, at 6:27 a.m. on charges of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor, and interference with public duties, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $500 on the trespass charge and $1,000 on the interference charge. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

No bond had been set on either charge at the time of booking. He is also being held on an out-of-county/state hold.
